verdict: SiteGround: Choose SiteGround when managed WordPress on shared-plan packaging at a $17.99 ongoing floor is the job — not a Plesk panel licence, and not WP Engine by default. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
weaknesses: Shared-plan depth below specialist managed WP
bestFor: Teams that want managed WordPress hosting with a published $17.99 ongoing floor

notIdealFor: Admins buying Plesk or DirectAdmin licences for servers they already own
Teams that need WP Engine specialist depth or Kinsta GCP isolation as the award path
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models
Module stacking and consumption overages vs single-SKU floors

recommendation: Choose SiteGround when managed WordPress on shared-plan packaging at a $17.99 ongoing floor is the job — not a Plesk panel licence, and not WP Engine by default. Compare WP Engine for WordPress-specialist managed hosting; Kinsta for GCP-isolated managed WP; Cloudways for managed multi-cloud VMs; Plesk only on landscape pages for panel licences.
